chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Uqba, from Abu Kahmas, who said:

A man said to Abdullah ibn Al-Hasan, 'Teach me something regarding sustenance.' He said, 'Stick to your prayer mat when you have prayed Al-Fajr until the sun rises, for it is more effective in seeking sustenance than traveling in the land.' I informed Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) of this, so he said, 'Shall I teach you regarding sustenance what is more beneficial than that?' I said, 'Yes.' He said, 'Trim your moustache and your nails every Friday.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended practice for increasing sustenance according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi presents a layered approach to sustenance, contrasting spiritual diligence (remaining in prayer after Fajr) with physical effort, before elevating a specific act of grooming—trimming the moustache and nails on Fridays—as even more effective. In Shia tradition, this highlights the interconnection between ritual purity (taharah) and divine provision, suggesting that maintaining one's physical state in accordance with the Sunnah is a means of attracting barakah. The Imam’s correction implies that while prayer is foundational, specific acts of following the Prophet’s example in personal hygiene hold unique merit for rizq.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Uqba, from Abu Kahmas who said,

‘A man said to Abdullah Bin Al-Hassan, ‘Teach me something regarding the sustenance’. So he said, ‘Necessitate upon yourself to stay in your Prayer mat when you have Prayed Al-Fajr, up to the emergence of the sun, for it is more beneficial in the seeking of the livelihood than the going about in the land, for I informed Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> with that, so he<sup>asws</sup> said, ‘Shall I<sup>asws</sup> teach you regarding the livelihood what is more beneficial than that?’ I said, ‘Yes’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Take from your moustache and your nails, every Friday’.
en.sarwar: 11. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn ‘Uqbah from abu Kahmas who has said the following:

“A man once asked ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Hassan to teach him something for increased sustenance. He said, ‘Remain in the place of your Salat (prayer) after the morning Salat (prayer) until sunrise; it is more useful for seeking increased sustenance than traveling in the land.’ I informed abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about it and he (the Imam) said, ‘Will you like if I teach you for increased sustenance what is more useful than that?’ I replied, ‘Yes, I will like it.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘Clip your fingernails and mustache every Friday.’”
